claim_boundary: Eighteen fencers from a three-group cross-sectional exercise/cognition study. The joined CC BY table includes physical fitness, cognitive-task, and pre/post blood measures, but no fencing weapon, bout, skill label, athlete identity, or longitudinal training intervention. Exact study codes and ages are removed. The source styles F2 post-CTSB as an outlier; the value is retained with an explicit flag. Repeated pre/post columns are measures on the same 18 people, not additional participants.
